title: Philosophy
tagline: Twenty-five centuries of argument, from Thales to Martha Nussbaum
hero_file: "The School of Athens" by Raffaello Sanzio da Urbino.jpg
hero_caption: Raphael, The School of Athens, fresco in the Vatican's Stanza della Segnatura, 1509–11
intro: A self-study map of Western philosophy: 112 key figures across 2,500 years, each with a full hand-written entry covering life, ideas, key works, influence, criticisms and the first thing of theirs to read. Around it sit a learning path, era overviews, themes, a glossary, common misconceptions, work-level study guides, Anki decks and in-depth focus studies of six philosophers.
